evals.prompt: Create a new KMP project called TaskManager with package com.acme.taskmanager. Output it to /tmp/kmp-out. All platforms.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs create-kmp.sh with --name TaskManager --package com.acme.taskmanager --output /tmp/kmp-out --yes --no-git and relays the next steps; no files are hand-written.
assertions: no occurrence of MyApp, myapp or com.example remains in the generated text files

evals.prompt: New KMP app: WeatherApp, package io.weather.app, output /tmp/kmp-out-2. Android and iOS only.
evals.expected_output: Script run with --platforms android,ios. app/desktop, app/web and app/server are absent; deploy-web workflow is removed; packages follow io.weather.app.app.<module> with no special casing.
assertions: app/desktop, app/web and app/server do NOT exist
app/common classes are under io/weather/app/app/common with package io.weather.app.app.common

evals.prompt: Bootstrap NoteSync KMP project, package me.notes.sync, /tmp/kmp-out-3.
evals.expected_output: The skill asks nothing further, confirms, runs the script, and does not create a git commit.
assertions: the project directory has no .git directory
gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar exists or the response reports the download warning
the response points to README.md, AGENTS.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md

evals.prompt: Create KMP app Foo, package com.acme.foo, output /tmp/kmp-out-4. What secrets do I need to add to GitHub?
evals.expected_output: The answer's secret names match the generated secrets/SECRETS.md exactly; none are invented or taken from memory.
assertions: the response lists secrets that all appear in /tmp/kmp-out-4/Foo/secrets/SECRETS.md
the response says the Android keystore was already generated
